summary.text: HAMRE ELEKTRONIKK AS (911 787 040), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2013-03-19; address Bjørnengveien 10A, 1664 ROLVSØY, Norge. Main industry is Manufacture of other electrical equipment (27.900); 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Tom Arne Johansen; Board chair: Monica Eileen Kleven Johansen; Auditor: TOTAL REVISJON DA. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 10.49 m, operating profit NOK 963.43 k, net profit NOK 714.89 k, equity NOK 4.40 m, total assets NOK 7.61 m.
